description: SAPOS-Daten is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. SAPOS data is data received on SAPOS reference stations as satellite signals and, together with other descriptive data (metadata) about the reference stations, is made available to SAPOS users in prepared form and in various formats. SAPOS data can contain information from a network calculation or be generated in a network calculation. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "SAPOS data" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include AdVMIS. The listing shows 2019-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
